text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ghh~~~~!! To think I'd only manage a place 
finish~~~~!
choice_data_list: Still, you can make it to the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Even if that's true! I wanted to be number 
one!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
How could I ever be satisfied with a 
result like this?! Next time, without 
fail...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph! Well, that was true, but still!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still, you shouldn't get arrogant over a 
single win. True victory is when you leave 
them completely crushed.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Don't be so soft. You're my 
Trainer, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Feel more frustrated, fire yourself up, 
and engrave it in your heart that you 
won't give up 1st place next time."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Let's start training the moment we get 
back! I'm gonna make up for everything I'm 
lacking, just watch!
